reviews.text: It is China’s first national park, located about 1 hour drive from Shangri-La old town, altitude around 3,500m - 4,100m meters above sea level. It is part of the Three Parallel Rivers UNESCO World Heritage area , focusing on ecological protection. Breathtaking views and wonderful experience. Potatso is higher than Lijiang, so you may feel slight headache, shortness of breath and faster heartbeat. Dont run, walk slowly and use your oxygen cannister.

November might not be the best time to visit this park, with partial park closure (only accessible to 2 lake locations) and dry pasture. Didi from Shangrila old town RT around 200 yuan, entrance ticket is 138 yuan, and additional 65 for the boat ride for each lake which is like 5 mins ride, you can see the next pier…pretty mandatory unless you want to walk 4 km for each stop. Maybe it’s just not for me, if you like walking trail then should be ok. I’d opt out and do Balagezong, Meili, Abujico, etc.

Was there end August 2025 as part of the tour package that we signed up for. Park is huge ! We arrived on a rainy day. We took the bus ride and the boat ride (at I believe Shudu Lake). It was a looong walk in the drizzles and dont know what to expect. Anyway, we were glad to be back at the restaurant / retails for a warm bubble tea after a 70mins walk in the drizzles. Was told to keep pumping Oxygen, so, we did just that. Probably, had we come on a sunny day, it would be better experience.

Don’t come here! Ticket price is CNY 138 which includes ferries within the park. But I don’t think that worth it. The scenery was normal for me. There is 2 lakes to visit Shudu lake and Bita sea. Nothing special though There’re extra charged scenery. Boating on Shudu lake. Hiking on primal forest and leaping in forest. I don’t think this is a national park but a business square in a mountain.

The park indeed lives up to its reputation and is clearly one of the best in China. Unfortunately there were intermittent showers when we were there, which made our exploration a bit more challenging....we had to take a few stops along the way. Nevertheless, it was a good outing.

Visited in November. Apart from yellow trees, no other Autumnal colours. Already very cold especially in the shade and frost could be seen on the ground. Pleasant overall but nothing much to be seen. Thought that the Jade Dragon Snow Mountain and Blue Moon Valley nearer Lijiang looked more like a national park with the majestic snow covered mountain peaks. Only visit if you have time and enjoy nature walks.

Potato National Park truly lives up to its name. The area looks amazing during this season, dotted with wild yaks and horses as you traverse through the lush forests of the national park. There are plenty of hiking trails for visitors as well as a scenic ferry and bus ride as well. If you are lucky, you can even spot the glorious Yulong Snow Mountain’s peak!

From the main entrance after you buy the entrance ticket, walk in to get a bus ride. If you love nature scenery, may spend half day to walk, to dance, to get a boat ride, drink a cup of coffee to feel how lucky you are to be able to step in this beautiful piece of land.

It's a big national park but still under development. Short bus ride from entrance of park will bring visitors to the main attraction area. Wild animals roam free while we can explore on boardwalks. Convenience store selling drinks and snacks is available but of course at a marked up price. Option to opt for boat ride back to another bus pick up point to get back to entrance car park but it's actually a very walkable distance.

Veey beautiful national park with great scenery. Can be very cold and windy. Bring warm clothes, or you can rent jackets there too. Public toilets were clean. Really nice and well maintained walking paths. And you can also take the option of taking a boat across the lake if you dont want to walk.

Very beautiful national park with great scenery but most of the park is not accessible to the public. There are only 3 tourist spots here and you’ll have to pay additional for a bus ticket to access the bus which brings you to each spot (in the designated order stated by the park). Would recommend dedicating 4-5 hours to visiting if you are keen to walk all the three trails in the tourist spots (2-3km each). Toilets are available at the start and end of every trail as well. The trails are mostly reasonably well maintained boardwalks or paths without too much steps.

Pudacuo National Park 普达措国家公园 is about 30 kilometres or half an hour by car from Dukezong 独克宗古镇. It is a UNESCO World Heritage Site. The park is top notched and very well managed. To get around, you will need to hop on the park’s shuttle buses. The buses will take visitors to Shudu Lake 属都湖 and Bita Lake 碧塔海. A leisurely afternoon will take about 3-4 hours stopping by for photography and taking in the natural beauty. We visited during winter, the cold dry wind bites, so proper winter attire is needed to keep warm. Also take note of the 3.600 - 3,700 meters altitude which may affect those sensitive to high altitude sickness - not a laughing matter. We really enjoyed the afternoon soaking in the sunshine, clear sky, and nature’s beauty. A must visit is highly recommended. Foreigners need passports when purchasing tickets. No need to book any private tour, just catch a Didi and you will be there in 30 minutes.

The entry and gateway is not a fair representation on the well maintained majestic natural landscape beyond. The large boulder lookalike ticketing counter is a shocker. The branding has a strong American Ranger feel to it... probably similar to somewhere in Milwaukee. I wished they sold the emblem as collectible stickers. Instead they are too preoccupied selling tebitean spiritual tokens. I've been giggling the while time imagining the park is named Potato 🥔 😐🙃 The bus shuttle brings you around from the large lake to the small one. Quite a good place to chill and relax overall. Easily spend 5 hours of the day here. Bring some nibbles and plenty of water to stay hydrated throughout your hike!

We visited in December and spent almost 6 hours enjoying ourselves at Potatso National Park. The weather is clear with clusters of snows over everywhere. The natural environment is wonderful. You can feed birds and squirrels with biscuits.

The landscape is beautiful but it was super crowded and we couldn’t really enjoy the experience. Many people only interested in taking pictures and using disposable oxygen bottles are making this really not sustainable

China's first National Park, modelled against America's national park. Could be better, perhaps because we were there during winter and the scenery were not so colourful and spectacular. Scenery is beautiful, main and only prescribed attraction is to walk around the lake, a 3km easy walk where you catch see the alpine landscape.

An amazing park with spectacular views and wildlife. Pity a large portion have been cordoned for rejuvenation work. Go early to enjoy the best of the view. Smokers are reminded to surrender their lighters at the gate or risk heavy fines if they are caught (there are smokers room available). Stroll slowly and if possible, get a knowledgeable guide as there is much nature going on or you may missed the wonder of the park little things. For those worry about the thin oxygen, please bring along the canned oxygen, available for sales at the park. Drone pilots will be happy, drones are allowed at the Shudu Lake.
Beautiful scenes. Not in the right season for my visit though. Part of the park was closed for maintenance as well..

Very disappointed with the visit here. Possibly due to some of the park being closed, but I found neither lake particularly impressive. The views were pretty normal and I thought it was not at all worth the time

No not Europe but enchanting Yunnan China Coniferous trees, squirrels, lakes , blue sky, crystal clean air What a gorgeous land to stroll , relax ,and immerse oneself to the peaceful charm of this glorious National Park . I was there in November 2024 , the temperature was 9C but sunny Not crowded at all and relaxing

Recommend buying the cheaper ticket which excludes the fantasy character storyline that is indoor at the end of the whole tour of the park. Which easily people might not have time for it anyway unless you have the whole day. From the first bus ride (first lake tour), you can choose to get off the bus at the first stop and trek. Or you could continue the ride which ends at second stop and have 3 options. 1) Walk + payable ferry ride, 2) Buggy ~180per pax farm tour, 3) 90rmb per pax bicycle ride(~30mins) + 1 free ferry ride at the end of the bike track @pier4. I chose the bike ride and recommend it. It is beginner friendly track mostly. Make sure to take the bike crew’s contact before setting off. Upon reaching ferry point4, call them for the ferry ride to the end ferry point where you will walk 400m to the end of the tour around the lake. Where you can purchase food and drinks and take the shuttle bus to the park entrance or continue the ride to the next lake. I would recommend calling the bike crew and constant pressuring them for the ferry as they seem to want to accumulate more bikers(very few chose this route) before summoning the ferry over to pier4. This ferry from pier4 is upon demand only and is the only way bikers have to get back. It’s funny how we just left the bikes at the pier and there were no instructions because it’s quite obvious we shouldn’t bring the bikes up the ferry. I waited for 30mins and had seen people complained worse.

This is supposed to be China’s first national park - be as it may - it is a very good one… awesome preserved natural habitat, great scenery, lush green spaces, lakes , rivers … flowers ; you get to do lots of hiking, breath the fresh clean air Enjoy
Absolutely a 5-star national park in any scale... especially for China. The white snow and the serenity is incomparable to the buzzing towns or cities in other part of the country.
Need to take the bus to reach to point of interest. The guide in the bus only explain in Chinese on how the bus route works. Boat ride is available @ RMB 50.
Very nice scenery. Enjoyed the peace and serenity strolling through the various parts of the National Park.

Don’t even think that you’ll be able to enjoy the pristine natural environment like if you were in a national park. There is no way that you can walk by yourself in nature. Every little stop is super structured, the bus takes you from point A to point B to point C with hundreds and hundreds of people behind you taking selfies. It feels like you are part of herd of animals being guided around by fences. Seriously annoying and also is quite expensive the enter through the park and also the transportation. If you are a nature enthusiast this is not the place for you.

Amazing place. We came slightly before spring so there isn't much flowering but the view and slow hike through the park still amazing. Eye opening for us to see this vast land of habitat. Thankfully the weather is good and sunny.
Awe-inspiring natural beauty @ 4000+ meters above sea level. be mindful to go slow if you are not accustomed.

Managed to walk the entire 3.3km hiking trail alongside Shudu Lake The water was muddy and the surrounding landscape was not impressive. Only about one quarter of the hiking trail for Bita Lake was open. The trail was fenced off just before the water's edge. All we got to see were yaks grazing in the pasture. Highly not recommended for the price and the transport to go there!

Breathtaking landscape with beautiful scenery, of great lakes, clear skies and nice hills as backdrop. Interesting to have a nice stroll in the morning, around the lake. However, there are buses to offer lifts to selected stops, for those may not wish to have strenuous exercises. Do come early morning or in the evening to avoid the hot pelting sun!! A great place for the nature loving fan.
Good view. Nice to take a walk and relax your mind. But it can be too cold since it was too windy. So wear proper attire
Don't expect a day trek in a pristine natural park. Expect buses taking you from one point to another. With 2-3km stralls on paved paths full of people taking selfies. Site is still beautiful.

With the specular misty hills and calm waters, this is a most amazing place on Earth! You get to see the beautiful and delicate wonders of life and nature. Highly recommended to anyone with reasonable fitness conditions as the walk can be demanding due to the high altitude.
Not recommended to visit during March.. snow covered every place but good experience for those who wish to see snow.
The first national park established in China. If you enjoy tracks and walks. It's a good one. However there are so many people. If you want a nice and quiet walk, try your luck.

Visited on 06/05/2021, 80% of the park is closed since 2017... You take a bus that bring you to the first lake, you can only walk a few hundreds meters by a the lake on a wooden path then take a bus back to entrance.... Total rip-off and waste of time. Spend more time on bus and shops then into the wild...
For adult price, buy online will be cheaper than buying on the spot. For old people > 65 buying on the spot will have discount. Some parts maybe closed, check before coming.
I didn’t choose the right time. I should go there a month later, in Autumn, when the leaves are yellow and read.

This is one of the UNESCO sites in Yunnan province, and is a huge park in high altitude areas. Theres several stops in the the park where you can drop off from the excursion bus to explore. We did not have sufficient time to finish every spot. Still a nice place to visit for the fresh air and less crowds.

Very beautiful lake and pine forest area with yarks are good for relaxation. Boat trip is interesting. Two to four kilo walk is just enough for photo shooting and health. Total 3 to 4 hr shoould spend joyfully. Suviniour shopping have good quality snd fair price here.

We visited Potatso National Park at the end of November. Started the trail at 10:45am and finished around 2pm… about 3 hours at a relaxed pace. There weren’t many people on the trail, which made it feel even calmer. We slowed down, played with the stones, and watched the yaks just chilling there, completely unbothered. Wide open space… and everything felt slower.
普达措國家公園，‘’措‘’藏語湖的意思，屬都湖主要景區，海拔3550公尺有環保區搭乘约14公里到達，高原湖泊，有棧道步行環湖，全長3公里。藍天白雲，山巒碧水，風光明媚，慢慢走著，雖走在高原上，毫無高原反應。 難得體驗。
11-07-2025 ＊公园占地广，群山环绕，但开放的区域少 只有<<属都湖3.3km 木栈道>和 <<碧塔海1km来回2km>>这2个湖和限时开放的步道（2点前） 整个园区，非常人工化，而且游客会乱喂食松鼠， ＊缺少原野气息，拍照商业化 ＊沿着木栈道走远远就听到广播 要拍照，卖照片 ＊一路除了牛马和三只松鼠，并没有看到属于原始徒步林道 ＊要看湖景天色一线还是有的 麦理芝蓄水池完胜
中國第一個國家公園，地區內原始生態環境豐富保存完好。換句話說，絕大部分的區域是禁止遊客進入的。對一般觀光客而言，只能待在特定開放的路徑上，不斷支付費用，景色不錯但在雲南應屬平庸等級。不建議特地前往。
4月中旬前往 搭環保巴士20分鐘前往屬都湖 沿著平緩步道走約3公里 大概一個小時 風還不小吹著頭疼 沿途風景很單調生態也還好 季節還屬於高海拔冬季 草枯牛馬瘦 湖水呈現混濁草綠色 再搭20分鐘巴士回出口就結束此行
Công viên đẹp và bình yên. Đi bộ dạo chơi trong này cả ngày cũng dc Mình và nhóm bạn rất thích Nếu nhờ người bản địa mua vé thì rẻ hơn so vs bạn tự mua
佔地廣闊，裡面要坐接送大巴士，車上有解說員，遊湖船在進園時就要另外買，有3個主要景點，到站點下車都是要走的，看完坐車再到下一站，四面環山大片牧場 有牛羊，草原都是濕地不能下去，人都是走在棧道上，能看的不多，上面有一個環保厠所海拔3595m。

Mooi park, maar zou ik overslaan. Je kunt bijna alleen over een boardwalk langs het meer. De prachtige velden met Yaks scheur je langs met de parkbussen. Er naar toe lopen mag niet! Dit is wel een tip voor de parkeerbeheerders. Zowel westerse als Chinese toeristen komen graag voor de Yaks in hun natuurlijke omgeving.

ไม่ใช่ที่นี่ จะรีวิวช่องเขาเสือกระโจนเพิ่ม กรณีที่เดินจากที่พักเรา Ryoseizanin Guesthouse ที่อยู่บนเขาตรงข้ามเทือกเขาหิมะมังกรหยก หันหน้าเข้าหาเทือกเขาแล้วเดินไปทางซ้าย เป้าหมายสู่ Tina's guesthouse ข้างล่างบริเวณหุบเขาเสือกระโจน โดย‌เอางบซื้อแพกเกจทัวร์ภูเขาหิมะมังกรหยกที่ลี่เจียง 500กว่าหยวน มาใช้จ่ายตรงนี้แทน รู้สึกว่าคุ้มค่ากว่ามาก ใกล้ชิดมังกรหยกแบบธรรมชาติจริงๆ วิวสวยตลอดทาง

Công viên quốc gia Pudacuo (hay còn gọi là công viên quốc gia Potasto, tên tiếng Anh: Potatso National Park hay Pudacuo National Park) nằm ở Shangri-La, khu vực tự trị Tây Tạng Di Khánh, tỉnh Vân Nam. Vườn quốc gia Pudacuo có diện tích 1.313 km2 và có nguồn tài nguyên sinh thái vô cùng phong phú. Nằm trong khoảng độ cao từ 3.200 m đến 4.159 m so với mực nước biển. Công viên này được xây dựng vào năm 2007 với mục đích bảo tồn tài nguyên thiên nhiên quốc gia. Vườn quốc gia Phổ Đạt Thố có cảnh quan đẹp, môi trường sinh thái được bảo tồn tốt, hồ trên núi yên tĩnh và trong vắt, đồng cỏ rộng lớn, có những vùng đất ngập nước đầy hoa và rừng nguyên sinh tươi tốt. Đây thực sự là điểm đến du lịch rất đáng để bạn ghé qua một lần trong đời.

【普达措国家公园】 普达措国家公园，海拔3500-4159米，内有高山草甸、湖泊湿地、牧场森林，整个国家公园由三个主要的景点构成，蜀都湖、弥里塘和碧塔海，现在除了蜀都湖其他都不开放，是一个不来觉得遗憾，来了更后悔的地方，就是普通的森林公园，毫无特色可言。 交通 香格里拉客运站每天有四班去普达措的班车，出发时间分别为08:00、08:30、09:30，返程时间分别为14:00、14:30、15:00和16:30，车费单程15元/人，车程半小时左右。 包车 费用单程约100元，往返150-200元，拼车约50元/人 门票 通票 (门票+观光车):80人民币 开放时间 7:30-16:00 （4-10月） 8:30-16:00（11-3月） 在月光广场旁的游客中心买了门票+往返大巴110元/人的套票，安全便利。 因为是淡季，也不用提前一天预定，每天会有9点和9点半2趟车，返回时间大约是在下午3、4点。

Vườn quốc gia Pudacuo (普达措国家公园/ Pudacuo National Park) cách thành phố Shangri-La khoảng 22km, với độ cao tối đa 4.159,1 mét và nhiệt độ trung bình hàng năm là 5,4 °C. Nó có hai hồ nước, một khu vực trung tâm du khách, một làng dân tộc thiểu số và khu vực đồng cỏ. Có 3 điểm tham quan chính đó là hồ Bita (碧塔海) ở phía Nam, hồ Shudu (弥里塘) ở phía Bắc và ở giữa là Đồng cỏ Militang (弥里塘)

Khi du lịch Trung Quốc bạn sẽ biết công viên quốc gia Pudacuo không chỉ đẹp mà còn rất rộng lớn. Pudacuo có tổng diện tích gần 1.300 km², nằm cách trung tâm Shangrila khoảng 22 km. Công viên này được xây dựng vào năm 2007 với mục đích bảo tồn tài nguyên thiên nhiên quốc gia. Pudacuo được hình thành từ hai vùng đất ngập nước có tầm quan trọng đối với thế giới đó là Khu Bảo tồn thiên nhiên Hồ Bita và Tam Giang Tịnh Lưu. Pudacuo còn là công viên quốc gia đầu tiên ở Trung Quốc đáp ứng đủ các tiêu chuẩn thiên nhiên của Tổ chức Bảo tồn Thiên nhiên Quốc tế (IUCN). Nơi đây gây ấn tượng với du khách về việc thiết lập đầy đủ các quy định bảo vệ thiên nhiên, tham quan và du lịch sinh thái. Pudacuo cũng được UNESCO công nhận là một Di sản thiên nhiên thế giới. Công viên quốc gia Pudacuo ở Shangrila đẹp huyền ảo như chốn thiên đường giữa nhân gian. Công viên quốc gia Pudacuo ở Shangrila đẹp huyền ảo như chốn thiên đường giữa nhân gian. >>>Xem thêm: Một số lời khuyên hữu ích cho tour Lệ Giang Shangrila Cảnh sắc thiên nhiên Khung cảnh thiên nhiên của công viên quốc gia Pudacuo nổi bật với nhiều hồ, vùng ngập nước, cánh rừng hoang dã, suối chảy róc rách, thác nước đổ trắng xóa, bãi cỏ tự nhiên, hoa dại tràn ngập khắp mặt đất. Nơi đây còn nổi tiếng với hàng loạt những loại cây quý, đẹp mắt như: Đỗ quyên, Kim ngân, Vân sam rồng, Vân sam đài hoa dài, Vân sam rồng, Bạch dương đỏ, Bạch dương bạc Siberi, Sam hạt đỏ lá dài, Cây thủy tùng…Và hàng trăm loại lan tuyệt đẹp, quý hiếm khác. Pudacuo với tài nguyên rừng phong phú và đa dạng các loại cây quý hiếm. Pudacuo với tài nguyên rừng phong phú và đa dạng các loại cây quý hiếm. Pudacuo còn là nơi sinh sống của nhiều loại động vật quý, cực hiếm,như: sếu đầu đỏ, sếu cổ đen, các loài cá,..Và hàng trăm loài chim di cư đến Pudacuo vào mùa thu đông, như chim nhạn, chim hạc…Tạo nên một cảnh sắc thiên nhiên hoang dã vô cùng phong phú, sinh động. Khung cảnh thiên hoang dã ở Pudacuo. Khung cảnh thiên hoang dã ở Pudacuo. Khí hậu ở Pudacuo cũng vô cùng đặc biệt, quanh năm đều ẩm ướt, sự chênh lệch nhiệt độ giữa ban ngày và ban đêm vô cùng rõ ràng. Mùa xuân và mùa hè, công viên quốc gia Pudacuo hiện lên như một tấm thảm xanh khổng lồ với cảnh sắc thiên nhiên tươi xanh mơn mởn. Những cơn mưa rào tưới quét qua cánh rừng, khiến cỏ cây càng trở nên linh động, đẹp mắt đến lạ thường. Đến mùa thu, sắc lá trên cánh rừng dần chuyển màu tạo nên một bức tranh màu sắc đa dạng, rực rỡ. Khi mùa đông đến, những chú chim di cư đến đây sinh sống rất nhiều. Hòa trộn cùng màu tuyết trắng xóa phủ khắp nơi vô cùng tuyệt đẹp. Chọn đi tour du lịch Trung Quốc mùa nào cũng đều sẽ được chìm đắm vào nơi tiên cảnh giữa nhân gian này với từng hương sắc, vẻ đẹp khác nhau.
剛從海拔2000多公尺的雲貴高原，到了近4000公尺的青藏高原。此時，行進宛如太空人、一步一腳印、步步踏得穩妥緩慢，唯恐高原反應，感受到氧氣的可貴。 沿著長長的木棧道緩行，雖非春花綻放 芳草鮮美，但冬季朗空的高山湖泊 顯其冷冽的冰清之美，有時 雲在天上，也在水中。
Hồ trên núi với bãi cỏ và mặt hồ rộng, được bảo tồn rất tốt. Lần đầu đi đến vùng núi cao nên oxy hoà tan trong máu giảm nhanh, phải hạn chế vận động mạnh.

管理极其混乱，进公园只能坐公园运营的大巴，然而大巴发车时间不一定，既不是人满开车，也不是定时发车，全凭司机心情。我们隔壁一队银发旅游团在风雪里足足等了1个小时才坐上。 另外，公园景色绝美，然而大巴车沿途没有停靠，只能被动的在唯二开放的两个景点和大门口下车拍照。 坐在车里观景：车窗污浊都是泥巴点，不知道这是什么设计？ 园区公路不让旅客下车步行，碧塔海栈道只开放1.5公里让你走到距海300米处观望一下，不知道花138的门票来这里有什么意义？ 总而言之不推荐。

Rừng nguyên sinh quốc gia Pudacuo rất rộng lớn, nằm trên cao nguyên Tây Tạng. Khu du lịch là thung lũng nằm giữa 2 dãy núi, có hồ nước rộng, nên đi bộ vòng quanh hồ để ngắm quanh cảnh rừng nguyên sinh. Hơi đáng tiếc có quá ít động vật, chỉ có vài con sóc hiếm hoi lắm mới nhảy ra, còn lại là ngựa, dê, bò Yak dân thả nuôi. Nên đi mùa đông để ngắm các loài chim di cư đến hồ chắc thú vị hơn. Nhìn chung với cá nhân tôi, khu du lịch này không thú vị.

［普達措國家公園］是中國第一個國家公園，為世界自然遺產「雲南三江併流保護區」的重要組成部分，也是拉姆撒國際濕地的重要組成區域。 它於2007年6月21日正式開始接待遊客，是國家5A級旅遊風景區。 主要景點有屬都湖、碧塔海和高原牧場。 普達措至今保持完整的原始森林生態系統。園內有清澈如鏡的高山湖泊、水草豐美的牧場、茂密的森林、成群的牛羊以及星星點點的牧棚和青稞架，置身湖畔，讓人感受到高原人閑散、悠遊的生活情趣。 #幸福生活不只在於豐衣足食，也在於碧水藍天！

普達措國家公園，有三大景區，屬都湖景區、彌里塘景區和碧塔海景區。2019年6月到訪，只開放屬都湖景區，票價RMB 100.-包括景區旅遊巴士。遊客可選擇乘景區巴士直達屬都湖，或中途站下車，走2.2公里，行程約1小時的屬都崗河生態步道，再轉乘車前往屬都湖。屬都崗河生態區算是一道開胃菜，主菜在屬都湖。生態步道是身在河岸中；若在巴士内，來回程都可，能窥屬都崗河全貌，洲渚多，似蓮葉何田田，屬都岡河流，婉婉游戲過。與生態步道，兩種感受。屬都湖可選擇乘船到對岸停車場，或取道全長3.3公里的沿湖步道前往停車場。沿湖步道分佈幾個風景區。其中杜鵑長廊和枯木群是精萃。到訪正值杜鵑花期，普達措公園花開 處處。在屬都崗河生態步道河岸，一株，兩株小杜鵑亭立，白花掛满，枝葉藏隱。遠看去，雪白娥娥，遺世獨立，悽然心動。要看鼎盛繁華，莫過杜鵑長廊了，處於属都湖沿湖步道中後段。魚貫迎來大小杜鵑，花開十里；特别是大杜鵑，朶朶燦然，惹人注目。杜鵑開在，湖光山色下，古木青葱裏，悠然心曠。長松蘿是普達措公園常見的植物，當地人稱樹鬍子，依樹倒掛，羅纱般。長松蘿配杜鵑，羅纱上織花。這樣賞杜鵑是其它地方沒有見過。枯木群是最後一段，碩大灰白的枯木躺卧湖岸，或舒卧，或張爪，蒼天無語。跟繁花處另一境地。 隨著普達措公園的動物跟外界接解漸多，習慣開始改變。並不是好事。旅途中，見旅客以巧克力餵食小松鼠，松鼠不但不怕人，更機靈搶走巧克力；另見野豬待在路邊討食。 交通：獨克宗古城及香格里拉市客運客站有車前往。車程约40分鐘。

景色是有的，但公园收费不便宜（138/人），摆渡大巴时刻安排混乱，到了蜀都湖必须要走3.3km的栈道，或是再花50乘坐游船，才能到去往下一站碧塔海的接驳点（摆渡车会赶人，你不能跳过这个景点直接去下一站），而且明明有近路，摆渡车会先花20分钟开回景区大门口，再走另一方向去碧塔海，令人困惑。作为国家公园，园区里却到处都是人工的痕迹，包括景点出现的牦牛和马，一看就知道不是野生动物。碧塔海说是经过生态恢复重新开放，却只有很小一部分能看到，实在是不值得票价。 总结，如果普达措也配得上国家公园，那我国国家公园的门槛也未免太低了。这样的标准，配不上我国如此丰富的自然旅游资源。

Công viên Potatso (普达措国家公园) [Pudacuo National Park] là một khu bảo tồn thiên nhiên vô cùng rộng lớn và chỉ với 3% diện tích mở cho khách du lịch tham quan. Qua cửa soát vé, bạn sẽ lên xe buýt đợi sẵn ở cửa để đưa vào sâu trong khu bảo tồn, với mỗi xe đều có 1 hướng dẫn viên đi kèm theo xe để giới thiệu (mỗi tội không có Tiếng Anh chỉ thuyết minh tiếng Trung ). Sau khoảng 20 phút thì xe buýt sẽ đưa bạn tới chặng đầu tiên là hồ Thuộc Đô (属都湖 – Shudu Lake), ở đây bạn có thể lựa chọn phương án xuống đi bộ ven theo con đường gỗ bên hồ hoặc ngồi tiếp tục trên xe buýt để được đưa tới cuối chặng này, các bạn chú ý là nếu đã xuống đi bộ thì sẽ phải đi hết chặng (gần 4km) mới tới được điểm xe buýt tiếp theo. Hồ Shudu rộng 120 ha, nằm ở độ cao hơn 3300m trên mực nước biển, cách cổng chính của công viên Potatso khoảng 13 km. Cái tên Shudu có nghĩa là hồ nước nằm bên cạnh quả đồi. Hồ Shudu nổi tiếng với cá “nứt bụng” – một loại cá toàn thân vàng rực và dưới bụng có một vết nứt, thường được ví với hóa thạch sống của hồ. Nước hồ Shudu rất trong nên du khách có thể dễ dàng nhìn thấy loại cá này bơi tung tăng sát mép nước. Vào mùa hè, từ tháng 5 đến cuối tháng 10, đồng cỏ quanh hồ Shudu là nơi chăn thả bò Yak chủ yếu của người Tạng. Vì vậy, nếu bạn yêu thích thiên nhiên thì nên ghé thăm hồ Shudu vào mùa chăn thả để được tận mắt nhìn thấy những đàn bò Yak lông dài, những đàn ngựa và dê thong thả gặm cỏ trên thảo nguyên bát ngát, mênh mông cũng như có cơ hội hiểu thêm về cuộc sống thực sự của những người dân tộc Tạng nơi đây.
